exact_title: KDIGO 2021 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Glomerular Diseases
source_type: clinical practice guideline with data supplement; May-2024-stamped PDF of the 2021 guideline
organization: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) Glomerular Diseases Work Group
version_or_date: October 2021 publication; supplied main PDF modified/reissued May 2024 with explicit outdated-chapter notices
reference_range: main guideline S256–S276; supplement references distributed after evidence tables

coverage_decision: All substantive main chapters, 100 figures, 6 main tables, and supplement Tables S1–S218 were inventoried. Deprecated Chapters 9/10 are represented as a version-control boundary rather than active clinical guidance.
omissions_and_reasons: Individual evidence-profile rows in the data supplement were not converted to primary-study LiteratureAtoms; the guideline is a secondary source.
Biographic/disclosure prose and bibliography entries were not atomized.
The external 2024 replacement chapters for AAV and lupus nephritis were not retrieved because they were not supplied and @VERIFY was not activated.
